title: Undergraduate Research (UC Santa Cruz)
lab_or_program: Undergraduate Research
description:
UC Santa Cruz's central Undergraduate Research office helps students of every major get involved in research, connecting them with faculty mentors, funding, and named scholar and fellowship programs. It is the campus hub for discovering opportunities, learning how to get started, and finding support for undergraduate research and creative projects.

From the program page: Discover research At UC Santa Cruz, undergraduates are at the heart of groundbreaking research. From creative projects to scientific discoveries, students have the unique opportunity to collaborate with world-class faculty, gain hands-on experience, and explore future career paths—all while contributing to the pursuit of knowledge. title: Student Funding & Fellowship Opportunities (UC Santa Cruz Office of Research)
lab_or_program: Office of Research
description:
The UC Santa Cruz Office of Research's student funding hub lists fellowships, grants, and scholarship opportunities supporting undergraduate and graduate research. It points students to internal and external funding for research projects, conference travel, and fellowship applications across disciplines.

From the program page: Student Funding Opportunities This page contains resources for graduate students who are seeking outside funding to support their research. Graduate students should work closely with their faculty advisor when preparing a fellowship application. Additional financial resources for graduate and undergraduate students can be found on the UC Santa Cruz Financial Aid and Scholarships page . STEM Fellow
